title: EAI System Profile Extension Payload
description: Optional extension payload for linking an EAI case to a non-normative AI system profile.

profile_ref.description: Stable identifier or URI of the system profile used in the case.

observed_configuration.description: Optional label for the concrete deployment or configuration observed in the case.

observed_ai_actions.description: Canonical EAI AI-action identifiers or labels observed in the case.

system_profile_snapshot.description: Optional immutable reference to the profile state used for audit or reproducibility.
